caption_L1: Here a bar graph is named Number of new passenger car registrations of leading car brands in France between 2016 and 2018 , by brand. There is a categorical scale from Audi to Volkswagen on the x-axis, labeled leading car brands. Along the y-axis, 2018 is drawn.
caption_L2L3: The two brands with the most new car registrations in France between 2016 and 2018 were Peugeot and Renault. Renault had over 400,000 registrations, and Peugeot followed just below 400,000. The next highest was Citroen with just over 200,000 new registrations. Volkswagen and Dacia both had around 140,000 new registrations. All other car brands in France had 100,000 new car registrations or less between 2016 and 2018.
